   36  def policy() -> dict:
   37      p = data.read_json(POLICY)
   38      old = single.policy()
   39      expected = {**old, "study": "fixed_H_natural_regrouped_query_consistency", "methods": ["H_cons"],
   40          "pooling": method.identity(), "training": method.training_identity(),
   41          "evaluation": dict(bootstrap_replicates=5000, bootstrap_seed=20260930,
   42              comparisons=[["H_cons", "S"], ["H_cons", "G_half"]], primary_metric="map", primary_role="raw",
   43              success="B_end_H_cons_minus_S_each_AB_MAP_CI_lower_strictly_positive")}
   44      if p != expected:
   45          raise ValueError("Approved fixed H_cons policy differs")
   46      return p

   49  def config() -> dict:

   55  def sources() -> list[dict]:
   56      paths = {data.ROOT/n for n in ("scripts/step28_h_consistency_run.py", "scripts/step28_h_consistency_verify.py",
   57          "tests/test_step28_h_consistency.py", "tests/test_step28_g_half.py", "tests/test_step28_record_replay.py")}
   58      todo = list(paths)
   59      while todo:
   60          for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(todo.pop().read_text(encoding="utf-8"))):
   61              names = [x.name for x in node.names] if isinstance(node, ast.Import) else [node.module] if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) else []
   62              for name in names:
   63                  if name and name.startswith("step28_"):
   64                      child = data.ROOT/"scripts"/(name+".py")
   65                      if child not in paths:
   66                          paths.add(child)
   67                          todo.append(child)
   68      paths.update(data.ROOT/"schema"/name for name in ("step28_h_consistency_policy.json", "step28_g_half_policy.json",
   69          "step28_record_replay_policy.json", "step28_bge_continual_policy.json", "step28_alias_ranking_policy.json",
   70          "step28_chinese_base_policy.json"))
   71      paths.update((BASELINE, AUTHORIZATION, RECOVERY_AUTHORIZATION, NATIVE_AMENDMENT, data.ROOT/"docs/SELLER_ALIAS_H_CONSISTENCY.zh.md",
   72                    data.ROOT/"scripts/run_step28_h_consistency_linux_20261016.sh",
   73                    single.BASELINE, single.AUTHORIZATION, data.ROOT/"docs/SELLER_ALIAS_G_HALF.zh.md",
   74                    data.ROOT/"scripts/run_step28_g_half_linux_20261015.sh"))
   75      return [data.record(path, data.ROOT) for path in sorted(paths)]

   78  def baseline_runs() -> dict:
   79      manifest = data.read_json(BASELINE)
   80      if (data.sha256(BASELINE) != "b71119f5f278776cfa64f2a175acbadecc1614e8103a869319d9270522ececf3"
   81              or len(manifest["files"]) != 52 or set(manifest["baselines"]) != {"S", "H"}):
   82          raise ValueError("Approved S/H saved scope differs")
   83      for row in manifest["files"]:
   84          data.verify(data.ROOT/row["path"], row)
   85      for row in manifest["unchanged_direct_sources"]:
   86          data.verify(data.ROOT/row["path"], row)
   87      runs = {}
   88      for info in manifest["baselines"].values():
   89          root = data.ROOT/info["root"]
   90          old = data.read_json(root/"run/manifest.json")
   91          col = data.read_json(root/"evaluation/collected.json")
   92          split = data.read_json(root/"run/partition.json")
   93          if (col["group_ids"] != [r["group_uid"] for r in split["development"]]
   94                  or col["domains"] != [r["domain"] for r in split["development"]]
   95                  or col["columns"] != list(parent.metrics.COLUMNS)
   96                  or old["initials"][info["arm"]] != info["initial_identity"]):
   97              raise ValueError("Saved alignment/initial identity differs")
   98          for name in info["points"]:
   99              if set(col["points"][name]) != set(parent.ROLES):
  100                  raise ValueError("Saved role coverage differs")
  101          runs[info["arm"]] = (root, col, old)
  102      a, b = runs["S"], runs["G_half"]
  103      if (data.read_json(a[0]/"run/partition.json") != data.read_json(b[0]/"run/partition.json")
  104              or a[2]["public_inputs"] != b[2]["public_inputs"]):
  105          raise ValueError("S/H inputs/partition differ")
  106      return runs

  116  def loss_total(row: dict, stage: int, arm: str) -> float:
  117      if any(row.get(k) != v for k, v in method.metadata(arm).items()):
  118          raise ValueError("Update scoring/training identity differs")
  119      total = 0.
  120      for role, weight in (("current", 1.), ("history", .1)):
  121          if role == "history" and stage == 1:
  122              if "history" in row:
  123                  raise ValueError("Unexpected A history")
  124              continue
  125          r = row[role]
  126          if r.get("qualification_without_c") is not False or r["mse1"] is not None:
  127              raise ValueError("Formal update used qualification mode or wrong teacher")
  128          if role == "current" and r["mse0"] != 0:
  129              raise ValueError("Current branch used birth teacher")
  130          expected = dict(supervised_contribution=weight*r["supervised"],
  131              consistency_contribution=weight*r["consistency"], teacher_contribution=.5*r["mse0"],
  132              distillation=r["mse0"])
  133          for key, value in expected.items():
  134              if not np.isfinite(value) or not np.isclose(r[key], value, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-6):
  135                  raise ValueError("Wrong explicit H_cons contribution: "+role+"/"+key)
  136          contribution = sum(expected[k] for k in ("supervised_contribution", "consistency_contribution", "teacher_contribution"))
  137          if not np.isclose(r["weighted"], contribution, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-6):
  138              raise ValueError("Weighted branch omitted a contribution")
  139          total += contribution
  140      if not np.isclose(row["total"], total, atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-6):
  141          raise ValueError("Actual total omitted H_cons contribution")
  142      return total
  143

  145  def validate_diagnostic(value: dict, arm: str) -> None:
  146      if any(value.get(k) != v for k, v in method.metadata(arm).items()):
  147          raise ValueError("Diagnostic H_cons identity missing")

  150  def native_objective_pair(off: dict, on: dict, stage: int) -> dict:
  151      """Check actual FP32 branch arithmetic; scalar inequality is only diagnostic."""
  152      loss_total(on, stage, "H_cons")
  153      if any(off.get(k) != v for k, v in method.metadata().items()):
  154          raise ValueError("Native control identity differs")
  155      roles = ("current",) if stage == 1 else ("current", "history")
  156      if stage not in (1, 2) or (stage == 1 and "history" in off):
  157          raise ValueError("Native objective stage differs")
  158      details, totals = {}, [0., 0.]
  159      for role in roles:
  160          a, b = off[role], on[role]
  161          for key in ("supervised", "consistency", "mse0", "distillation", "mse1", "assignment_sha256"):
  162              if a[key] != b[key]:
  163                  raise ValueError("Native on/off base terms or allocation differ: "+role+"/"+key)
  164          weight = np.float32(1. if role == "current" else .1)
  165          for index, row in enumerate((a, b)):
  166              if row["qualification_without_c"] is not (index == 0):
  167                  raise ValueError("Native C switch differs")
  168              for key in ("supervised", "consistency", "mse0"):
  169                  if not np.isfinite(row[key]) or float(np.float32(row[key])) != row[key]:
  170                      raise ValueError("Native component is not the actual finite FP32 value")
  171              expected = (weight*np.float32(row["supervised"]),
  172                          np.float32(0. if index == 0 else weight)*np.float32(row["consistency"]),
  173                          np.float32(.5)*np.float32(row["mse0"]))
  174              for key, number in zip(("supervised_contribution", "consistency_contribution", "teacher_contribution"), expected):
  175                  if row[key] != float(number):
  176                      raise ValueError("Native explicit FP32 contribution differs: "+role+"/"+key)
  177              weighted = float(np.float32(np.float32(expected[0]+expected[1])+expected[2]))
  178              if row["weighted"] != weighted:
  179                  raise ValueError("Native FP32 addition order differs")
  180              totals[index] += weighted
  181          details[role] = dict(consistency=b["consistency"], contribution=b["consistency_contribution"],
  182                               off_weighted=a["weighted"], on_weighted=b["weighted"])
  183      if off["total"] != totals[0] or on["total"] != totals[1]:
  184          raise ValueError("Native total differs from actual branch sum")
  185      return dict(roles=details, off_total=totals[0], on_total=totals[1],
  186                  actual_difference=totals[1]-totals[0], totals_equal=totals[0] == totals[1],
  187                  component_reference_difference=sum(r["contribution"] for r in details.values()),
  188                  fp32_branch_arithmetic_verified=True)
  189  
  190  
  191  def validate_native(value: dict) -> None:
  192      if (value.get("training_identity") != method.training_identity()
  193              or value.get("consistency_precision_verified") is not True
  194              or len(value.get("table_precision", [])) != 5):
  195          raise ValueError("Actual native H_cons table precision/training identity missing")
  196      updates = value.get("updates", [])
  197      if len(updates) != 6:
  198          raise ValueError("Native six-call logs missing")
  199      for phase, index, stage in (("current", 1, 1), ("paired", 3, 2)):
  200          if value.get("objective_pairs", {}).get(phase) != native_objective_pair(updates[index]["log"], updates[index+1]["log"], stage):
  201              raise ValueError("Native rounded objective evidence missing or inconsistent")
  202          for component in ("encoder", "head"):
  203              effect = value.get("effects", {}).get(phase, {}).get(component, {})
  204              adam = effect.get("adam", {})
  205              rows = adam.get("parameters", [])
  206              active = [r for r in rows if r.get("state_present")]
  207              if (adam.get("finite") is not True or not active
  208                      or {r["name"] for r in active} != set(effect.get("active_parameter_names", []))):
  209                  raise ValueError("Native on/off Adam mapping/evidence missing")
  210              for row in active:
  211                  for key in ("step", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
  212                      delta = row.get(key, {}).get("max_abs_delta", float("nan"))
  213                      if not np.isfinite(delta) or delta < 0:
  214                          raise ValueError("Native on/off Adam difference missing/nonfinite")
  215                  expected_step = 2 if phase == "current" else 337
  216                  if row["step"].get("off") != expected_step or row["step"].get("on") != expected_step:
  217                      raise ValueError("Native on/off Adam clock differs")
  218  
  219  
  220  def validate_native_requalification(gate: dict, prior_seconds: float, output: Path) -> int:
  221      if gate.get("requalification_authorization") != data.record(RECOVERY_AUTHORIZATION, data.ROOT):
  222          raise ValueError("Specific native requalification approval missing")
  223      auth = data.read_json(RECOVERY_AUTHORIZATION)
  224      if (auth["status"] != "APPROVED_OBJECTIVE_GATE_REQUALIFICATION" or prior_seconds != auth["prior_charged_seconds"]
  225              or prior_seconds != 90 or output != data.ROOT/auth["attempt_output"]
  226              or auth["maximum_cumulative_gpu_seconds"] != 600 or auth["maximum_total_updates"] != 9
  227              or auth["prior_actual_updates"] != 3 or auth["attempt_updates"] != 6):
  228          raise ValueError("Native requalification scope or cumulative charge differs")
  229      for key in ("supplement", "primary_static_review", "failed_result", "failed_wallclock"):
  230          data.verify(data.ROOT/auth[key]["path"], auth[key])
  231      failed = data.read_json(data.ROOT/auth["failed_result"]["path"])
  232      wall = data.read_json(data.ROOT/auth["failed_wallclock"]["path"])
  233      if (failed["status"] != "FAIL" or failed.get("actual_updates") != 3 or len(failed.get("updates", [])) != 3
  234              or failed.get("native") is not None or wall["cumulative_charged_seconds"] != prior_seconds
  235              or not failed.get("traceback", "").rstrip().endswith("ValueError: Current candidate-control objective indistinguishable")):
  236          raise ValueError("Only the approved three-update objective-gate failure can requalify")
  237      return auth["prior_actual_updates"]

  261  if __name__ == "__main__":
  262      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
  263      parser.add_argument("--job", type=Path, required=True)
